functions.name: public.is_super_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_user()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', '') = 'testuser01@example.com'
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.app_admins
      where profile_id = auth.uid()
        and is_active = true
    );
$function$

functions.name: profile_link_private.guard_club_owner
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION profile_link_private.guard_club_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if current_user in ('anon','authenticated') and ((TG_OP = 'INSERT' and new.owner_id is distinct from auth.uid()) or (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and new.owner_id is distinct from old.owner_id)) then raise exception 'グループ所有者を変更できません'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$
